niche: Gaming facts, trivia and lore: hidden secrets, development history, cut content, record-breaking moments and the backstories behind iconic video games
audience: Gamers aged 13-34 who scroll Shorts between sessions: console, PC and retro fans who love 'wait, really?' moments, dev secrets, speedrun oddities and deep lore from franchises like Zelda, Mario, Pokémon, Halo, Elden Ring and GTA
tone: Fast, punchy and curious, like a friend who knows every secret. It opens with a hook in the first second, gives tight facts with a hint of humor and awe, keeps a quick rhythm with no filler, and ends on a payoff or twist
done_topics: Atari's secret 1983 burial of E.T. cartridges in a New Mexico landfill, dug up in 2014

Nintendo began in 1889 as a Kyoto shop selling hand-painted hanafuda playing cards. After card sales collapsed, it ran a taxi company and sold instant rice. A worker's homemade toy arm then steered it into toys and video games.
